title: Buaflow budget evidence v1
description: What this app measured, with the command that produced each number and the file it came out of. Deliberately has no field for a threshold: the ceiling belongs to the application profile, so the same app passes or fails depending on what it claims to be rather than on a number it chose for itself.

profile.description: The application profile id whose budgets apply. Changing it changes the bar without touching the app.

subject.description: Which page or flow this number is about, so the worst one can be named.

command.description: The repeatable command that produced the source file.

path.description: Dot path to the number inside the source file, for timing metrics. Axe metrics are counted from the violations array instead.
